fullstack.title: Injeniyeri full-stack (Next.js / Node)
fullstack.summary: Uzubaka kandi ukurikirane porogaramu za web, portals na API abakiriya bacu bakoresha buri munsi, kuva ku gishushanyo cya mbere kugeza ku bufasha mu ikoreshwa.
do: Kubaka ibikorwa ku mpande zose ukoresheje TypeScript, Next.js na Node
Gutegura imiterere y’amakuru na API hamwe n’ikipe
Gushyira mu ikoreshwa, gukurikirana no gukosora ibipfuye
Kuganira n’abakiriya ngo wumve ikibazo kiri inyuma y’icyifuzo
bring: Nibura imyaka ibiri wubaka porogaramu za web
Ubumenyi buhamye bwa TypeScript cyangwa JavaScript, SQL na Git
Kwita ku tuntu duto abakoresha babona
Kwandika neza Igifaransa cyangwa Icyongereza; Ikinyarwanda ni akarusho

technician.title: Umutekinisiye wo hanze (ibikoresho n’imiyoboro)
technician.summary: Uzashyiraho, ufate neza kandi usane ibikoresho n’imiyoboro abakiriya bacu bishingikirizaho, i Kigali no mu gihugu hose.
do: Gushyiraho no gutunganya mudasobwa, imashini zisohora impapuro n’ibikoresho by’imiyoboro
Gusuzuma no gusana ibikoresho aho biri no mu igaraje
Gukora gahunda zo kubungabunga ku bakiriya bafite amasezerano
Kwandika buri gikorwa muri help desk
bring: Uburambe mu gusana ibikoresho no mu miyoboro y’ibanze
Gukora kuri gahunda no gutuza imbere y’abakiriya
Kwemera gukora ingendo ujya ku bakiriya

open.title: Ubusabe ku bushake
open.summary: Nta mwanya ukubereye uyu munsi? Tubwire icyo ukora neza n’aho ushaka gutera imbere; tubika buri busabe.
do: Tubwire ikipe wakwinjiramo: ikoranabuhanga, igishushanyo, serivisi zo hanze cyangwa ubucuruzi
Dusangize umurimo wishimira: code, ibishushanyo, imishinga cyangwa abakwemeza
bring: Amatsiko n’umuco wo kurangiza ibyo utangiye

sales.title: Ubucuruzi
sales.text: Ibiciro, gutumiza ibikoresho, licences n’imishinga mishya.

items.a: Sisitemu, porogaramu n’ibikoresho byanditse mu masezerano yawe: kugera kuri help desk, igihe cyo gusubiza kiri hejuru, kubungabunga no gusura aho biteganyijwe.
Andikira help desk cyangwa uduhamagare mu masaha y’ubufasha. Tanga izina ry’ikigo, icyabaye n’uko byihutirwa; uhabwa nomero ya ticket.
Akenshi yego. Tubanza gusuzuma igikoresho tukakubwira icyo dushobora gufasha n’igiciro mbere y’uko akazi gatangira.
Yego, mu gihugu hose. Gusura hanze ya Kigali biteganywa nawe mbere; urugendo rubarwa ukwarwo keretse rubarirwa mu masezerano yawe.
Igihe gitangira ari uko utanze kode igaragara kuri ecran yawe, ubona ibyo umutekinisiye akora byose, kandi ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

meta.description: Uko Linse ikusanya, ikoresha kandi irinda amakuru bwite (imbanzirizamushinga).

intro.heading: Ibanga ryawe rifite agaciro kuri twe.
body: Inyandiko y’agateganyo. Politiki y’ibanga izatangwa kandi ihindurirwe muri Studio.
Urutonde rukurikira rugaragaza ibice politiki ya nyuma izaba ikubiyemo. Mbere y’uko isohoka, ibibazo ku makuru bwite byoherezwa kuri {email}.

sections.title: Abo turi bo
body: Iki gice kizagaragaza Linsetech Ltd (“Linse”), Kigali, u Rwanda, nk’ishinzwe amakuru bwite akusanywa binyuze kuri uru rubuga, n’uko wayigeraho.

sections.title: Amakuru dukusanya
body: Iki gice kizerekana amakuru dukusanya: ayo wohereza ukoresheje ifishi (izina, imeyili, ikigo n’ubutumwa) n’amakuru y’ikoranabuhanga nk’impapuro wasuye n’ubwoko bw’igikoresho.

sections.title: Uko dukoresha amakuru
body: Iki gice kizasobanura impamvu tuyakoresha: gusubiza ibibazo, gutanga serivisi ku masezerano, kunoza urubuga no kubahiriza amategeko.

sections.title: Gusangiza abandi
body: Iki gice kizavuga ubwoko bw’abatanga serivisi badufasha gukoresha urubuga na serivisi zacu, n’igihe amategeko adusaba gutanga amakuru.

sections.title: Igihe tubika amakuru
body: Iki gice kizagaragaza igihe buri bwoko bw’amakuru bubikwa n’uko busibwa.

sections.title: Umutekano
body: Iki gice kizasobanura ingamba dufata mu kurinda amakuru kubura cyangwa kugerwaho n’abatabyemerewe.

sections.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
body: Iki gice kizasobanura uko wabona amakuru yawe, uko wayakosora cyangwa ukayasiba, uko wanga ikoreshwa ryayo n’uko watanga ikirego ku rwego rubishinzwe mu Rwanda.

sections.title: Cookies
body: Iki gice kizerekana cookies n’ikoranabuhanga risa nazo bikoreshwa kuri uru rubuga n’uko wabigenzura.

sections.title: Impinduka kuri iyi politiki
body: Iki gice kizasobanura uko impinduka zitangazwa n’igihe zitangira gukurikizwa.

sections.title: Twandikire
body: Ibibazo kuri iyi politiki: {email}.

intro.heading: Turagusaba gusoma aya mabwiriza witonze.
body: Inyandiko y’agateganyo. Amabwiriza y’ikoreshwa azatangwa kandi ahindurirwe muri Studio.
Urutonde rukurikira rugaragaza ibice amabwiriza ya nyuma azaba akubiyemo. Mbere y’uko asohoka, ibibazo byoherezwa kuri {email}.

sections.title: Kwemera
body: Iki gice kizasobanura ko gukoresha uru rubuga bivuze kwemera aya mabwiriza.

sections.title: Ikoreshwa ry’urubuga
body: Iki gice kizagaragaza ikoreshwa ryemewe: nta gukoresha nabi, nta kugerageza guhungabanya urubuga cyangwa kwinjira muri sisitemu zacu nta ruhushya.

sections.title: Serivisi n’ibiciro
body: Iki gice kizasobanura ko imishinga, ibicuruzwa n’igurisha ry’ibikoresho bigengwa n’amasezerano yanditse n’inyemezabiciro byihariye.

sections.title: Umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
body: Iki gice kizagaragaza nyir’ibikubiye ku rubuga, ikirango na porogaramu zigaragara kuri uru rubuga.

sections.title: Imiyoboro y’izindi mbuga
body: Iki gice kizavuga ku miyoboro ijya ku zindi mbuga tutagenzura.

sections.title: Itangazo
body: Iki gice kizasobanura ko amakuru ari ku rubuga atangwa muri rusange kandi ashobora guhinduka.

sections.title: Imbibi z’uburyozwe
body: Iki gice kizagaragaza imbibi z’uburyozwe bwacu ku ikoreshwa ry’uru rubuga.

sections.title: Amategeko akurikizwa
body: Iki gice kizagaragaza amategeko agenga aya mabwiriza n’inkiko zikemura amakimbirane.

sections.title: Impinduka ku mabwiriza
body: Iki gice kizasobanura uko n’igihe aya mabwiriza ashobora kuvugururwa.

sections.title: Twandikire
body: Ibibazo kuri aya mabwiriza: {email}.
